understanding.completion: One measured invocation equals the source's step() (gpt2_ddp_training.py:102-105): optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True), then accumulation_steps=4 microbatches (micro_batch=1, sequence_length=128) of FP32 GPT-2 forward+backward under DDP with no_sync() on the first 3 microbatches and the gradient all-reduce on the last backward, then optimizer.step(), then torch.cuda.synchronize() as the source's internal completion boundary. run() returns the summed per-microbatch loss; observe() exposes the loss, every parameter gradient and every post-step parameter. The rank-0 serial global-batch reference, gradient/parameter closeness checks, exact replica broadcast, negative control, the separate bucket-inventory comm-hook run, the 3 profiled diagnostic runs and JSON report writing surround the invocation and are not part of it (request notes 'Harness vs work', 'One measured invocation').
understanding.state_protocol: prepare(context, request) applies the source numerical policy (common.py configure: torch.set_num_threads(4), best-effort set_num_interop_threads(1), torch.manual_seed(20261020), TF32 disabled for cuda.matmul and cudnn, cudnn.benchmark False, float32_matmul_precision 'highest'), builds GPT2LMHeadModel (n_layer=12, n_embd=768, n_head=12, vocab_size=50257, n_positions=1024, dropout disabled, eager attention, use_cache=False) on context['device'], wraps it in DDP(broadcast_buffers=False, bucket_cap_mb=25, gradient_as_bucket_view=True) over the worker's already-initialized process group, creates SGD(lr=0.001, momentum=0.0, weight_decay=0.0, foreach=False), generates the local rank's synthetic token inputs with torch.Generator().manual_seed(31000+rank) on the device, snapshots the initial state_dict on CPU, and, for world_size>1, creates the source's additional gloo control group used by before_run's barrier. reset(state) restores the initial seeded weights via raw_model.load_state_dict(initial), exactly the source reset() (gpt2_ddp_training.py:99-100); SGD with momentum=0 and weight_decay=0 holds no optimizer state, and gradient clearing stays inside run because the source's accumulate() starts with zero_grad(set_to_none=True) inside the timed invocation. run(state) executes the whole frozen step and returns {'loss', 'losses'}; observe(state, result) returns detached CPU tensors (loss, per-microbatch losses, all named gradients, all post-step named parameters); metrics(state, result, elapsed_ms) returns only clean project metrics in native units with the communication objective left to the framework's collector; models(state) exposes the raw GPT-2 module for discovery and controlled replacement. before_run(state) performs the gloo control barrier outside the timer; no process group is initialized or destroyed by the adapter.
invariants: Workload dimensions are frozen by request['workload'] and must be read from it at prepare() time, never embedded as constants: world_size=2, micro_batch=1, sequence_length=128, accumulation_steps=4 (effective batch 8, 1024 tokens per step); a separately validated variant may supply different values through the same fields (request.workload; request notes 'One measured invocation').

Precision and numerical policy are frozen (common.py configure; request notes 'Step semantics preserved'): FP32 weights, torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32=False, torch.backends.cudnn.allow_tf32=False, torch.backends.cudnn.benchmark=False, torch.set_float32_matmul_precision('highest'), model dropout disabled (resid/embd/attn pdrop 0.0), attn_implementation='eager', use_cache=False (make_model).

Deterministic seed policy is required so independent workers reproduce the same reference: torch.manual_seed(20261020) before model construction and per-rank inputs from torch.Generator().manual_seed(31000+rank) (make_model/make_inputs; request notes 'No external assets').

One invocation must contain the full accumulation, the required communication and the update (request notes 'One measured invocation'): loss divided by accumulation_steps, backward per microbatch, no_sync() on all but the last microbatch so exactly one DDP gradient all-reduce serves the whole accumulation, then a single SGD(lr=0.001, momentum=0.0, weight_decay=0.0, foreach=False) step, ending at the source's completion boundary torch.cuda.synchronize() (step(), gpt2_ddp_training.py:102-105).

The source's division between setup and timed work must be preserved (reset/run contract): reset() only restores initial weights from the CPU snapshot, while optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True) stays inside run() because accumulate() performs it inside the timed step (gpt2_ddp_training.py:37).

Correctness observations must be complete and unmodified (request quality; workloads.json quality_scope): the summed loss, every parameter gradient and every post-step parameter returned as full detached tensors; reference fidelity is checked by the framework against a serial single-GPU accumulation of the same global batch, including exact cross-rank gradient equality (gpt2_ddp_training.py:81-86); no accuracy or convergence is claimed beyond that.

The communication objective communication_kernel_sum_ms is measured by the framework's torch_communication collector in separate diagnostic runs (request objective.source with collector descriptor; rank_aggregation=max, median of 3 profiled runs); the adapter must not fabricate a value for it, install communication hooks merely to inventory buckets, or run a profiler inside run()/metrics().

step_ms keeps the source's timing semantics: max across ranks of one full accumulated step's local wall time, with control-group barriers outside the timed region (request notes; gpt2_ddp_training.py:116-119, 148-152).

Required communication must remain real: gradient synchronization through NCCL on the worker-initialized process group using context['device']; the adapter must not initialize another default process group or destroy it (worker ABI).
assumptions: Model architecture constants (n_layer=12, n_embd=768, n_head=12, vocab_size=50257, n_positions=1024) are taken from source workloads.json gpt2_ddp_training.model, because request assets are empty and the request freezes model architecture; these are fixed for all workload variants of this project.

The baseline's DDP construction kwargs (broadcast_buffers=False, bucket_cap_mb=25, gradient_as_bucket_view=True) replicate the source (gpt2_ddp_training.py:59); bucket sizing and reducer scheduling are implementation choices that later candidates may legitimately change to reduce NCCL kernel time, provided gradients stay exactly replica-consistent and the step_ms constraint holds.

SGD foreach=False, listed under the request's preserved step semantics, is kept for exact baseline replication even though a foreach update would be numerically identical for this elementwise SGD rule.

The worker has already initialized the NCCL process group and bound context['device'] (worker ABI); prepare() only creates the source's additional gloo control group for before_run's barrier, mirroring dist.new_group(backend='gloo') at gpt2_ddp_training.py:53.

before_run's gloo control barrier mirrors the source's pre-sample barrier (gpt2_ddp_training.py:114) and stays outside all measurement; it is redundant but harmless if the framework already aligns ranks.

The final torch.cuda.synchronize() remains inside run() because the source's step() defines that internal completion point; the framework's own boundary synchronization subsumes it without changing semantics.

reset() needs no optimizer-state restore because SGD with momentum=0.0 and weight_decay=0.0 carries no state; residual gradients from a previous invocation are cleared by zero_grad(set_to_none=True) at the start of the next run, matching the source exactly.

Source harness responsibilities deliberately excluded from run(): warmup/repeats sampling, rank-0 serial global-batch reference construction, gradient/parameter closeness checks, exact replica broadcast, negative control, the separate bucket-inventory comm-hook run, the 3 profiled diagnostic runs and JSON report writing (request notes 'Harness vs work').

metrics() returns only clean project metrics (step_ms, tokens_per_step, effective_batch, tokens_per_second, peak_allocated_bytes, parameter_count) in native units; the objective communication_kernel_sum_ms comes exclusively from the framework's torch_communication collector.

observe() returns detached CPU copies; the tied lm_head/wte weight appears once because named_parameters() deduplicates shared parameters, matching the source's parameters()-zip comparison (gpt2_ddp_training.py:74).

The held-out workload longer_sequence (sequence_length=256, accumulation_steps=2) in workloads.json is not part of this frozen request; the adapter reads all workload-dependent dimensions from request['workload'] so a validated variant can reuse it unchanged.

continuous_steps=2 is supported because each run() invocation is self-contained (zero_grad at start, one all-reduce on the last microbatch, one SGD update), so consecutive invocations without reset behave as consecutive training steps.
torch.set_num_interop_threads(1) is best-effort in case the worker already started parallel CPU work; every other configure() policy from common.py is applied unconditionally.
Task phases annotated for discovery are 'forward_backward' (the accumulation loop) and 'optimizer_step'; no optimization target or operator group is preselected.

understanding.goal: Reduce the source's diagnostic maximum-rank summed NCCL kernel duration for the accumulated training step, retaining its step-time constraint and full correctness checks.
understanding.completion: The measured invocation is one full accumulated DDP training step (gpt2_ddp_training.py step(), lines 102-105): optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True), then accumulation_steps forward/backward microbatches of micro_batch x sequence_length tokens each under DDP with no_sync() on all but the last microbatch and one gradient all-reduce on the final microbatch, then optimizer.step(), ending at the source's internal torch.cuda.synchronize() completion boundary. The step consumes world_size x micro_batch x sequence_length x accumulation_steps = 1024 tokens with effective batch 8. Harness work surrounding it (reference construction, gradient/parameter checks, exact replica broadcast, negative control, the separate bucket-inventory comm-hook run, the 3 profiled diagnostic runs, report writing) is not part of the invocation.
understanding.state_protocol: prepare() configures the source's numerical policy on context['device'], builds the seeded FP32 GPT-2 (torch.manual_seed(20261020)), wraps it in DDP(broadcast_buffers=False, bucket_cap_mb=25, gradient_as_bucket_view=True), creates SGD(lr=0.001, momentum=0.0, weight_decay=0.0, foreach=False), synthesizes per-rank token inputs (generator seed 31000 + source_rank) and snapshots initial weights to CPU. reset() restores those initial weights via raw_model.load_state_dict(initial) outside timing, mirroring the source's reset() (gpt2_ddp_training.py:99-100); gradient clearing is NOT moved into reset because the source performs optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True) inside the timed accumulate() (gpt2_ddp_training.py:37). before_run() reproduces the source's pre-step control-group barrier plus CUDA sync outside the timer. run() repeats the identical step from the restored start state each invocation (the 4 accumulation iterations are genuine internal work). The worker-initialized process group is never destroyed and no second default group is created; a gloo control subgroup is created only for coordination. observe() runs outside timing, clones loss, all gradients and updated parameters to CPU, and performs the exact cross-rank gradient broadcast check. metrics() queries CUDA peak statistics outside the timer.
invariants: Numerical policy is frozen by the request notes: FP32 weights, TF32 disabled for CUDA matmul and cudnn, torch.set_float32_matmul_precision('highest'), cudnn.benchmark False (common.py configure; request notes preserve precision).

Model architecture is frozen by the request: GPT-2 with n_layer=12, n_embd=768, n_head=12, vocab_size=50257, n_positions=1024, resid_pdrop=embd_pdrop=attn_pdrop=0.0, use_cache=False, eager attention (workloads.json gpt2_ddp_training.model; request forbids changing model architecture).

Workload dimensions are read from request['workload'] (world_size=2, micro_batch=1, sequence_length=128, accumulation_steps=4; effective batch 8; 1024 tokens per step) and must not be reduced or altered (request freezes batch, sequence length, effective training batch and work amount).

Task data are the source's declared seeded synthetic fixtures: weight initialization manual_seed(20261020) and per-source-rank token generator seed 31000 + source_rank with values in [0, vocab_size) (gpt2_ddp_training.py make_model/make_inputs; request notes declare these valid task data; assets is legitimately empty).

run() must execute the entire frozen workload: full gradient accumulation over all accumulation_steps microbatches, the required NCCL gradient all-reduce on the last microbatch, the SGD optimizer update, and the source's synchronize boundary (request: a training workload must include the full accumulation, required communication and optimizer update).

optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True) stays inside the timed invocation rather than being pre-cleared in reset(), because the source executes it within accumulate() on every step (gpt2_ddp_training.py:37); the source's setup/timed division must be preserved.

Exact discrete correctness checks are required in observe(), outside timed run(), because per-rank tolerance comparisons cannot enforce participant relationships: every parameter gradient must be identical across ranks via broadcast and assert_close(atol=0.0, rtol=0.0) (exact_gradient_replica_check, gpt2_ddp_training.py:81-86), the negative control must reject +1-corrupted gradients, and the training loss must be finite (request notes).

Reference fidelity uses the request's quality tolerances (grad_atol/parameter_atol 1e-06, grad_rtol/parameter_rtol 1e-04) against the serial single-GPU accumulation of the exact same global batch plus the post-step parameter comparison; the adapter must reproduce the source's full gradients, loss and updated parameters as observations so this check remains meaningful (request quality and notes; no accuracy or convergence claim beyond reference fidelity).

The step-time constraint step_ms <= 1.05x baseline (max across ranks of one full accumulated step's local wall time) applies to the full request; communication improvements may not trade away step time or the unchanged work amount (request objective.constraints).

The frozen objective communication_kernel_sum_ms is collected by the framework's torch_communication collector in separate diagnostic runs; the adapter must not fabricate, inline or approximate it inside run()/metrics() (request objective.source).
assumptions: Model dimensions are embedded as frozen architecture constants taken from workloads.json gpt2_ddp_training.model, because request['workload'] carries only workload-dependent dimensions; a separately validated workload variant (e.g. held-out longer_sequence with sequence_length 256, accumulation_steps 2) changes only workload fields through the same request structure while the architecture stays fixed.

The rank-0 serial global-batch reference, its gradient/parameter comparisons and negative-control scaffolding in the source are measurement and quality infrastructure surrounding the invocation; the framework stores reference observations on CPU, so this adapter does not allocate a second reference model on GPU. The baseline reproduces the source's exact gradient, loss and parameter values, which is what those comparisons verify.

The separate bucket-inventory comm-hook run and the 3 profiled diagnostic runs (median-of-3 max-rank NCCL kernel sum) are diagnostics owned by the framework; the baseline registers no communication hook and runs no profiler inside run()/metrics().

DDP reducer options (broadcast_buffers=False, bucket_cap_mb=25, gradient_as_bucket_view=True), SGD hyperparameters (lr=0.001, momentum=0.0, weight_decay=0.0, foreach=False) and no_sync() on the first accumulation_steps-1 microbatches are the source baseline's implementation choices reproduced faithfully here; they remain legitimate optimization surfaces as long as the exact cross-rank gradient check, the reference-fidelity tolerances and the step-time constraint still hold.

The source's gloo control group exists only for timing barriers; the adapter reproduces that coordination in before_run() (CUDA sync plus barrier) without re-initializing or destroying the worker's process group, falling back to the default group if gloo subgroup creation fails.

set_mode() only records the mode because the source has no separate correctness-capture path: execution semantics, work amount and observations are identical in quality, measure and profile modes; kernel_optimizer.project.discovery.phase annotations are labels only and add no work.

metrics() exposes the source's clean project metrics (step_ms, tokens_per_second, peak_allocated_bytes, loss, parameter_count, effective_batch, tokens_per_step) in native units; step_ms is the local wall time whose max across ranks is the constraint metric, and the communication objective is left to the framework's collector.
The held-out workload longer_sequence is not part of this frozen request and is not exercised; request['assets'] is empty by design because the entry never reads --assets.
